ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   B. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

6. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   D. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
   B. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. B — Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of care for plants; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
